# Repository Architecture Intelligence
Activate for unfamiliar features, planning, and cross-module changes.
1. Read project instructions and relevant README sections.
2. Map HTML asset order, JavaScript globals, CSS cascade, GAS endpoints, IndexedDB, service worker, and Test Mode.
3. Identify protected QR code and production/Test Mode boundaries.
4. Document affected files, contracts, dependencies, risks, and tests.
Avoid assumptions; verify source and test coverage. Quality means a complete but minimal change map.
